# Let me cycle Pink[0] through all states and record which match grid symbols
def extract_black_pattern(frame_ascii, r_start, c_start, height=5, width=5):
    lines = frame_ascii.split('\n')
    pattern = []
    for r in range(r_start, r_start + height):
        row = ''
        for c in range(c_start, c_start + width):
            row += '1' if lines[r][c] == 'B' else '0'
        pattern.append(row)
    return tuple(pattern)

initial_ascii = history[0].frame.ascii
grid_positions = {
    (0, 0): (5, 13), (0, 1): (5, 23), (0, 2): (5, 36), (0, 3): (5, 46),
    (1, 0): (14, 13), (1, 1): (14, 23), (1, 2): (14, 36), (1, 3): (14, 46),
    (2, 0): (23, 13), (2, 1): (23, 23), (2, 2): (23, 36), (2, 3): (23, 46)
}
grid_patterns = {}
for (r, c), (rs, cs) in grid_positions.items():
    grid_patterns[(r, c)] = extract_black_pattern(initial_ascii, rs, cs)

# Current state of Pink[0]
current_pat = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, 52, 15)
current_s = ''.join(current_pat)
current_matches = []
for (gr, gc), gs in grid_patterns.items():
    if current_pat == gs:
        current_matches.append(f"Grid[{gr},{gc}]")
print(f"Pink[0] current: {current_s} -> {current_matches if current_matches else 'no match'}")

# Cycle Pink[0] with UP and record states
print("\nCycling Pink[0] with UP:")
states = []
for i in range(6):
    action(['UP'])
    pat = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, 52, 15)
    s = ''.join(pat)
    matches = []
    for (gr, gc), gs in grid_patterns.items():
        if pat == gs:
            matches.append(f"Grid[{gr},{gc}]")
    states.append((s, matches))
    print(f"  State {i+1}: {s} -> {matches if matches else 'no match'}")

# Also record the initial state
print(f"\nPink[0] initial (before cycling): {current_s} -> {current_matches if current_matches else 'no match'}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
